mappings.source_table: Input CSV (path from sys.argv[1]; file name UNKNOWN)
mappings.target_table: Output CSV (path from sys.argv[2]; file name UNKNOWN)
mappings.logic: Group key, copied as-is with no trim or case change. Output rows are sorted ascending as strings: sorted(totals).
mappings.notes: Key is implied only by grouping (one output row per distinct account_id). No key is declared in the code. An empty-string account_id is accepted as a group.

mappings.source_table: Input CSV (path from sys.argv[1]; file name UNKNOWN)
mappings.target_table: Output CSV (path from sys.argv[2]; file name UNKNOWN)
mappings.logic: Count of non-skipped rows per account_id: counts[account_id] = counts.get(account_id, 0) + 1. Rows with a blank amount are not counted.
mappings.notes: Written as a plain integer. Zero, negative and duplicate rows are all counted. Other columns used for the skip test: amount.

mappings.source_table: Input CSV (path from sys.argv[1]; file name UNKNOWN)
mappings.target_table: Output CSV (path from sys.argv[2]; file name UNKNOWN)
mappings.logic: Per row: amt = float(amount). If currency = 'USD' then amt = round(amt * RATE, 2), with RATE hardcoded as 1.35; else amt unchanged, so any other currency value is treated as CAD. Then sum per account_id: totals[account_id] = totals.get(account_id, 0.0) + amt. Written as the string "%.2f" % totals[account_id].
mappings.notes: Other columns used: currency, account_id. Float arithmetic, with rounding applied per USD row and again at output. Can output -0.00. The hardcoded rate has no effective date.

rules.name: Read input rows
rules.logic: Reads every data row of the input file, using the header row as column names. No joins exist in the code.

rules.name: Skip blank amounts
rules.logic: Rows with an empty amount are dropped silently. They are not counted, not rejected and not logged. A whitespace-only amount is not dropped and raises an error.

rules.name: Sum and count per account
rules.logic: Equivalent to GROUP BY account_id with COUNT and SUM of the CAD-converted amount. USD amounts are converted first (see M03).

rules.name: Write output CSV
rules.expr: for acct in sorted(totals): w.writerow([acct, counts[acct], "%.2f" % totals[acct]])
rules.logic: Writes the header account_id, txn_count, total_cad, then one row per account in ascending string order. The file at sys.argv[2] is overwritten.
